Done. Summary:

- `out/T3/solution.py` loads the 160 input tensors, drops the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers, casts the 48 named projection weights to bfloat16, keeps everything else float32, runs the required assertions, then greedily packs the 148 tensors into shards ≤64 MiB (the 154 MB `wte.weight` lands alone in its own shard), writing `out/T3/model-*.safetensors` plus `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran once, succeeded on the first execution; verified 148 total tensors and shard sizes (63.19 / 63.19 / 39.08 / 147.24 MiB — only the oversized `wte.weight` shard exceeds the 64 MiB cap, as intended).
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written with the self-report.
